+``matplotlib.__version_info__``
+--------------------------------
+
+`matplotlib.__version_info__` is a new attribute, a tuple containing the
+release information (following :pep:`440`), which can be safely used to check
+whether the running Matplotlib is at least of a certain version, without the
+caveats that direct string comparisons of `matplotlib.__version__` are
+subject to::
+
+    if matplotlib.__version_info__ >= (3, 3):
+        ...

+def _parse_to_version_info(version_str):
+    """
+    Parse a version string to a tuple of the release info (PEP 440 §2.3).
+
+    This is a very rough implementation designed only to work well enough to
+    support ``__version_info__``.
+    """
+    v = parse_version(version_str)
+    if v.pre is None and v.post is None and v.dev is None:
+        return v.release
+    else:
+        return v.release + (v.pre or v.post or v.dev,)
+
